visual_brief.subject: Selecting a small task-specific tool and context set from a mature product archive
verified_context: Postman reported more tool-selection errors once an agent could see roughly 40 tools.
Its production architecture narrows more than 170 tools to about 15 relevant tools for a context-isolated subagent.
The team found missing or inaccurate context caused more failures than missing capabilities.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Agent quality depends on presenting the right small set of tools and purpose-shaped context, not exposing every capability at once.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A large curved architectural archive filled with varied physical instruments and context specimens, with a precise illuminated selection alcove holding a small coherent working set beside one focused worktable.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant. The archive and central worktable are elegant and readable, but the selected subset blends into the broader collection.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. The focused table and varied collection carry the context theme, though the selection boundary is implicit rather than architectural.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. The deep archive surrounds a bright, compact alcove containing a coherent working set, making the large-capability-to-small-context reduction unmistakable.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1100 x 591 center-cover review preserves the illuminated alcove and the surrounding archive tiers.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 193 center-cover review retains the small working set as the dominant focal area.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 review keeps the light-dark contrast between selected tools and the larger archive legible.

golden_reference_comparison: Direct review beside the Claude plugin ecosystem and Copilot review controls assets shows compatible warm stone materiality, curved architecture, contained tooling metaphor, and restrained amber focus. Candidate C is more detailed than the references but preserves their hierarchy and confident center-safe silhouette.
